title.zh: v2.0.72 文档引用门禁：文档声明的文件必须真的存在（7 处过期引用已修）
title.en: v2.0.72 A Documentation-Reference Gate: a File the Docs Claim Must Exist (Seven Stale Ones Fixed)

highlights.zh: **为什么文档在这里是承重的**：好几份文档是「这个设计为什么长这样」的唯一记录，而计划文档还负责写明**什么没做**。所以过期的文件引用是有害的——读者照着 `scripts/check_gs1.mjs` 去找，找不到，且**无法判断**它是从未建、被删除、还是被改名。手工一查找到 **7 处**。
highlights.en: **Why the docs here are load-bearing**: several are the only record of why a design is the way it is, and the plan document is also where "what is *not* done" lives. A stale file reference is therefore actively harmful — a reader follows `scripts/check_gs1.mjs` and finds nothing, and **cannot tell** whether it was never built, was deleted, or was renamed. A manual pass found **seven**.

highlights.zh: **已修正的引用**：① 门禁脚本真名是 `check-gs1.mjs`（连字符），文档写成了下划线——这是**唯一一处与可执行链路相关**的过期引用；② 更新记录的机制描述仍写着「编译进 bundle」，而它早已改成走网络的 `/version.json` + `/changelog.json`，被引用的那个模块也已不存在（已改写为实际机制，并保留当年那样做的理由与被取代的原因）；③ 一条测试覆盖的引用指向不存在的文件名（实际覆盖在另外两个文件里）；④ 计划表里一行「新 `…/SequencerStoreProvider.tsx`」被读成了断言，已明确标为计划。
highlights.en: **References corrected**: (1) the gate script is `check-gs1.mjs` (hyphen) and the doc wrote an underscore — the only stale reference tied to an executable path; (2) the release-notes mechanism was still described as "compiled into the bundle" when it has long since become `/version.json` + `/changelog.json` fetched over the network, and the module it named no longer exists (rewritten to the real mechanism, keeping both why it was done that way and why it was replaced); (3) a…

highlights.zh: **关键设计决定：不从散文里推断意图。** 计划文档本来就会提到尚未创建的文件，所以朴素检查会被误报淹没。我试了两次「按措辞判断这是不是计划」，**两次都是「失败开放」**：第一次按整行判断，于是同一行里另一个**过期**路径被顺带豁免；第二次把范围收到路径之前的从句，结果从句边界又把标记挤出范围，反而把真正的计划报成错误。两个方向都错，而**第一个是危险的那个**（过期引用可以搭上任何含「新增」二字的行）。因此现在：**缺失路径一律是问题**，除非它被显式登记在脚本的 `PROPOSED` 表里——登记是一条**可见的决定**而不是猜测，这也正是它能被复审的原因。当前登记 5 条，每条都写明「尚未建、现有实现是什么」。
highlights.en: **The design decision that matters: intent is not inferred from prose.** A plan document legitimately names files that do not exist yet, so a naive check drowns in false positives. I tried twice to decide "is this line a plan?" from its wording and **both attempts failed open**: line-wide, a planning word excused a *different*, stale path on the same line; scoped to the clause before the path, a clause boundary pushed the marker out of range and a genuine proposal was report…
